<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>We Love Deals — Welcome to the Family</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@500;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Poppins:wght@900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<!-- Lightweight physics engine for premium fireworks -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/canvas-confetti@1.9.2/dist/confetti.browser.min.js"></script>
<style>
  :root {
    --teal-dark: #042628;
    --teal-light: #0a4448;
    --orange-bright: #FF6D1F;
    --orange-dark: #C2500F;
    --cream: #FFF6EA;
    --white: #FFFFFF;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  body {
    font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, var(--teal-light) 0%, var(--teal-dark) 70%);
    color: var(--teal-dark);
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .page-container {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 30px 20px;
    animation: fadeIn 0.8s ease-out forwards;
  }

  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes popIn { 0% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0; } 70% { transform: scale(1.05); } 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }

  /* ---------- Branding ---------- */
  .logo {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 250px; 
    height: auto;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
    /* Soft shadow applied directly to the transparent logo */
    filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4));
  }

  /* ---------- 3D Sale Badge Text Banner ---------- */
  .headline-container {
    position: relative;
    padding: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 900;
    line-height: 1.1;
    z-index: 2;
    animation: popIn 0.7s ease-out forwards;
  }

  .line-small {
    font-size: 36px;
    color: var(--white);
    -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--teal-dark);
    text-shadow: 
      1px 1px 0px var(--teal-dark), 2px 2px 0px var(--teal-dark), 
      3px 3px 0px var(--teal-dark), 4px 4px 0px var(--teal-dark), 
      5px 5px 0px var(--teal-dark), 6px 6px 0px var(--teal-dark),
      7px 7px 0px var(--teal-dark), 8px 8px 0px var(--teal-dark);
    margin-bottom: -5px;
  }

  .line-hero {
    font-size: 54px;
    color: var(--orange-bright);
    -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--white);
    text-shadow: 
      -1px -1px 0 #fff, 1px -1px 0 #fff, -1px 1px 0 #fff, 1px 1px 0 #fff,
      1px 1px 0px var(--orange-dark), 2px 2px 0px var(--orange-dark), 
      3px 3px 0px var(--orange-dark), 4px 4px 0px var(--orange-dark), 
      5px 5px 0px var(--orange-dark), 6px 6px 0px var(--orange-dark), 
      7px 7px 0px var(--orange-dark), 8px 8px 0px var(--orange-dark);
  }

  .line-large {
    font-size: 46px;
    color: var(--white);
    -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--teal-dark);
    text-shadow: 
      1px 1px 0px var(--teal-dark), 2px 2px 0px var(--teal-dark), 
      3px 3px 0px var(--teal-dark), 4px 4px 0px var(--teal-dark), 
      5px 5px 0px var(--teal-dark), 6px 6px 0px var(--teal-dark), 
      7px 7px 0px var(--teal-dark), 8px 8px 0px var(--teal-dark);
  }

  /* Responsive scaling for mobile screens */
  @media (max-width: 440px) {
    .line-small { font-size: 8.5vw; }
    .line-hero { font-size: 13vw; }
    .line-large { font-size: 11.5vw; }
  }

  /* Decorative Sunburst Sparks */
  .spark {
    position: absolute;
    background: var(--orange-bright);
    border-radius: 999px;
    z-index: -1;
  }
  .spark-1 { width: 6px; height: 35px; top: -5px; left: 15%; transform: rotate(-45deg); }
  .spark-2 { width: 7px; height: 40px; top: -10px; right: 12%; transform: rotate(35deg); }
  .spark-3 { width: 5px; height: 25px; top: 40%; left: 0px; transform: rotate(-90deg); }
  .spark-4 { width: 6px; height: 30px; top: 45%; right: 0px; transform: rotate(85deg); }
  .spark-5 { width: 6px; height: 35px; bottom: 0px; left: 20%; transform: rotate(-135deg); }
  .spark-6 { width: 7px; height: 40px; bottom: -5px; right: 15%; transform: rotate(140deg); }

  /* ---------- Mascot Animation ---------- */
  .mascot-wrapper { flex-grow: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; position: relative; margin-bottom: 20px; animation: popIn 0.8s forwards; }
  .mascot-glow { position: absolute; width: 220px; height: 220px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,109,31,0.25) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 70%); border-radius: 50%; z-index: 0; animation: pulseGlow 4s infinite alternate; }
  .mascot-wrapper img { width: 240px; z-index: 1; border-radius: 20px; filter: drop-shadow(0 15px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)); animation: foxFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite; }

  @keyframes foxFloat { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(2deg); } }
  @keyframes pulseGlow { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.6; } 100% { transform: scale(1.3); opacity: 1; } }

  /* ---------- 3D Buttons ---------- */
  .btn-pill-3d {
    background: var(--orange-bright); color: var(--white); border: none; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; padding: 16px 40px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; z-index: 10; animation: popIn 0.9s ease-out forwards;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--orange-dark), 0 15px 25px rgba(255, 109, 31, 0.4); transition: all 0.15s ease;
  }
  .btn-pill-3d:active { transform: translateY(6px); box-shadow: 0 0px 0 var(--orange-dark), 0 5px 10px rgba(255, 109, 31, 0.4); }

  /* ---------- App Tab & Overlay ---------- */
  .app-tab {
    position: absolute; bottom: -100%; 
    left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 100%; max-width: 500px; height: 88vh;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border-radius: 36px 36px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 -15px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transition: bottom 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); padding: 24px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; z-index: 20;
  }
  .app-tab.open { bottom: 0; transform: translateX(-50%); }
  .swipe-handle { width: 50px; height: 6px; background: #CBD5E1; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 25px; cursor: pointer; }

  .overlay { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(4, 38, 40, 0.6); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; z-index: 15; }
  .overlay.show { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

  /* ---------- Carousel Deals UI ---------- */
  .app-preview-content { width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; }
  .launch-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background: #0B5C3E; padding:8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;}
  .launch-badge .dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--orange-bright); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,109,31,0.25); }

  .carousel { display:flex; gap:14px; width: 100%; overflow-x:auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; padding-bottom: 15px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display:none; }

  .deal-card { flex: 0 0 85%; scroll-snap-align: center; background: var(--teal-dark); border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; min-height: 160px; color: var(--cream); text-align: left; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);}
  .deal-card .tag { align-self:flex-start; background: rgba(255,109,31,0.15); color: var(--orange-bright); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; padding:4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom:12px; text-transform: uppercase;}
  .deal-card h3 { font-family:'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-size:22px; color: var(--white); margin-bottom:6px; line-height: 1.1;}
  .deal-card p { font-size:14px; color: rgba(255,246,234,0.8); line-height:1.4; }

  .dots { display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:8px; margin-top:10px; margin-bottom: 30px;}
  .dots span { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background: #CBD5E1; transition: all 0.3s ease;}
  .dots span.active { background: var(--orange-bright); width:20px; border-radius:4px; }

  /* ---------- Loading Overlay ---------- */
  .loader-overlay {
    position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; z-index: 50;
  }
  .loader-overlay.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
  
  .loader-box {
    background: var(--teal-dark); padding: 30px 25px; border-radius: 24px;
    text-align: center; color: var(--white); width: 85%; max-width: 380px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); transform: scale(0.9); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
  }
  .loader-overlay.active .loader-box { transform: scale(1); }
  
  .loader-box h3 { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; color: var(--white); line-height: 1.1;}
  
  .progress-bar-container { width: 100%; height: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);}
  .progress-bar { width: 0%; height: 100%; background: var(--orange-bright); transition: width 0.1s linear; border-radius: 999px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="page-container">
  
  <div class="overlay" id="overlay" onclick="toggleTab()"></div>

  <!-- Loading Box Overlay (Triggered on Launch) -->
  <div class="loader-overlay" id="loaderOverlay">
    <div class="loader-box">
      <h3 id="loaderText">Securing Deals...</h3>
      <div class="progress-bar-container">
        <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <img src="We Love Deals -02.png" alt="We Love Deals" class="logo">

  <!-- 3D Badge Headline without the background box -->
  <div class="headline-container">
    <!-- Radiating Sunburst Sparks -->
    <div class="spark spark-1"></div>
    <div class="spark spark-2"></div>
    <div class="spark spark-3"></div>
    <div class="spark spark-4"></div>
    <div class="spark spark-5"></div>
    <div class="spark spark-6"></div>
    
    <div class="line-small">WELCOME TO</div>
    <div class="line-hero">WE LOVE DEALS</div>
    <div class="line-large">FAMILY</div>
  </div>

    <div class="mascot-wrapper">
    <div class="mascot-glow"></div>
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Fox Mascot">
  </div>


  <!-- Main Launch Button -->
  <button class="btn-pill-3d" onclick="startAppLaunch()">Launch Now</button>

  <!-- Slide-up Tab -->
  <div class="app-tab" id="appTab">
    <div class="swipe-handle" onclick="toggleTab()"></div>
    <div class="app-preview-content">
      <div class="launch-badge"><span class="dot"></span>Live Now</div>
      
      <div class="carousel" id="carousel">
        <div class="deal-card">
          <div>
            <span class="tag">Book Lovers</span>
            <h3>20% off printed books</h3>
            <p>Sarasavi Bookshop — save on your next read, min. spend LKR 2,000.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="deal-card">
          <div>
            <span class="tag">Today only</span>
            <h3>50% off, Rs. 3,500</h3>
            <p>Ladies' College partner promo — half price on original Rs. 7,000 value.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="deal-card">
          <div>
            <span class="tag">New vendor</span>
            <h3>30% off stationery</h3>
            <p>Weerodaara Stationary Saver — min. spend LKR 2,000.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dots" id="dots"></div>

      <!-- Drawer Launch Button -->
      <button class="btn-pill-3d" style="width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; max-width: 400px;" onclick="startAppLaunch()">Launch Now →</button>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
  // Global variable to keep track of the initial endless fireworks
  let initialFireworksInterval;

  // --- 1. Initial Page Load Fireworks (Endless Loop) ---
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const defaults = { startVelocity: 30, spread: 360, ticks: 60, zIndex: 100, colors: ['#FF6D1F', '#FFF6EA', '#0B5C3E'] };

      // Set to an endless interval
      initialFireworksInterval = setInterval(function() {
        // Fire confetti from random edges of the screen
        confetti(Object.assign({}, defaults, { 
          particleCount: 40,
          origin: { x: (Math.random() * 0.8) + 0.1, y: Math.random() - 0.2 }
        }));
      }, 400); 
    }, 600); 
  });

  // --- 2. Tab & Carousel Logic ---
  function toggleTab() {
    document.getElementById('appTab').classList.toggle('open');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.toggle('show');
  }

  const carousel = document.getElementById('carousel');
  const cards = carousel.querySelectorAll('.deal-card');
  const dotsWrap = document.getElementById('dots');
  cards.forEach((_, i) => {
    const d = document.createElement('span');
    if(i === 0) d.classList.add('active');
    dotsWrap.appendChild(d);
  });
  
  const dotEls = dotsWrap.querySelectorAll('span');
  carousel.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const index = Math.round(carousel.scrollLeft / (cards[0].offsetWidth + 14));
    dotEls.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
  });

  let touchstartY = 0, touchendY = 0;
  document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { touchstartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY; });
  document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
    touchendY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
    if (touchstartY > touchendY + 60 && !document.getElementById('appTab').classList.contains('open')) toggleTab();
    if (touchendY > touchstartY + 60 && document.getElementById('appTab').classList.contains('open')) toggleTab();
  });

  // --- 3. Loading Box & Continuous Fireworks Logic ---
  function startAppLaunch() {
    // Clear the initial background fireworks loop
    if (initialFireworksInterval) {
      clearInterval(initialFireworksInterval);
    }

    const loaderOverlay = document.getElementById('loaderOverlay');
    const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
    const loaderText = document.getElementById('loaderText');
    
    loaderOverlay.classList.add('active');
    
    // Start intense fireworks specifically for the loading sequence
    const fireworksInterval = setInterval(() => {
      confetti({
        particleCount: 60,
        spread: 80,
        origin: { x: (Math.random() * 0.6) + 0.2, y: Math.random() - 0.2 },
        colors: ['#FF6D1F', '#FFF6EA', '#0B5C3E'],
        zIndex: 100
      });
    }, 250);

    let progress = 0;
    const loadingDuration = 2500; 
    const intervalTime = 50; 
    const increment = (intervalTime / loadingDuration) * 100;

    const loadingInterval = setInterval(() => {
      progress += increment;
      progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;

      if (progress > 40 && progress < 80) {
        loaderText.innerText = "Loading Offers...";
      } else if (progress >= 80) {
        loaderText.innerText = "Almost There!";
      }

      if (progress >= 100) {
        clearInterval(loadingInterval);
        clearInterval(fireworksInterval);
        
        loaderText.innerText = "Ready!";
        
        confetti({
          particleCount: 200,
          spread: 120,
          origin: { y: 0.6 },
          colors: ['#FF6D1F', '#FFF6EA', '#0B5C3E'],
          zIndex: 100
        });

        setTimeout(() => {
          executeDeepLink();
        }, 400);
      }
    }, intervalTime);
  }

  // --- 4. Deep Linking Execution ---
  function executeDeepLink() {
    const appScheme = 'welovedeals://app'; 
    const fallbackUrl = 'https://welovedeals.lk'; 
    const start = Date.now();

    window.location.href = appScheme;
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (Date.now() - start < 2000) window.location.href = fallbackUrl;
    }, 1500);
  }
</script>

</body>
</html>
